name: Nurse Call
source:
Kazuya struggles with a mysterious ailment. His p*nis can get hard, but can't ejaculate in the end.
It was deeply troubling to his girlfriend and he feared she would eventually leave him.
One day, while going through a back street, a sign for a strange urology clinic caught his eyes. "We can solve any of your sexual problems".
A cute receptionist greeted him, asking Kazuya to choose between 3 different nurses to look after him for a week...
Which girl will you choose?
translation:
和也正为一种难以启齿的怪病苦恼不已——他的阴茎虽然能够正常勃起，到最后却怎么也无法射精。
这让他的女友深感困扰，和也亦唯恐女友迟早会因此离自己而去。
某天，他穿过一条背街小巷时，一家古怪泌尿科诊所的招牌映入眼帘：“任何性生活方面的疑难杂症，本店皆可为您解决。”
一位可爱的接待员迎上前来，让和也在3名风格各异的护士中挑选一位，由她在接下来的一周里贴身照料自己……
你会选择哪位女孩呢？
